title: phaseolus vulgaris var. sargentone
intro: Phaseolus vulgaris var. sargentone, commonly known as the 'Sargent' bean or 'Sargent' kidney bean, is a variant of the common bean (Phaseolus vulgaris). This plant is used for its edible seeds and has been found to offer several health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and supporting the digestive system. The therapeutic actions of Phaseolus vulgaris var. sargentone include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its potential health benefits. The bioactive constituents of this plant include polyphenols, flavonoids, and anthocyanins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions and health benefits.
